data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD6 (forward-compat): handle pre-existing arbiter-rulings.json files written by the prior code path (no schema_version field, or schema_version<1.0.0). Pre-commit gate consumer must tolerate both schemas.

## Gap Analysis Origin
From b1b6 gap analysis (taxonomy: cross_task_interference). Spec introduces schema_version=1.0.0 but doesn't address sidecars from cycles that started before this code shipped.

## Implementation Notes
Update arbiter_processor.py to:
1. On read of existing sidecar in artifacts_dir, if schema_version missing OR < 1.0.0:
   - Log: "legacy sidecar detected, ignoring and overwriting"
   - Treat as absent; overwrite with new schema
2. Document the chosen behavior in module docstring
3. Pre-commit gate consumer should ALSO handle missing schema_version (existing gate code may need a touch — but only if it currently reads arbiter-rulings.json, which we'll grep to check)

## TDD Requirement
Add to test_arbiter_processor.py:

`test_arbiter_processor_handles_legacy_sidecar`:
- Given: artifacts_dir contains arbiter-rulings.json without schema_version field
- When: process_rulings called with new rulings
- Then: legacy file is overwritten with new v1.0.0 schema; log warning emitted; no exception raised

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Legacy sidecar test passes
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter_processor.py::test_arbiter_processor_handles_legacy_sidecar 2>&1 | grep -q passed

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Backward-compat handling for legacy arbiter-rulings.json sidecars (pre-arbiter_processor format)
